verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer a programmatic filing and search API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only a web online-filing system, a web entity-search database, and paper and mail options. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, the filing host reset the agent's connection, and the Business Express portal disallows crawling. Nothing shows an API at all, let alone one matching the UI.
